lines.text: Sandya's note is still here. Someone has replied underneath in different handwriting: 'Same problem with my mother. The office said to come in person.' The thread is growing.

card.title: CORRECTION NOTICE
card.body:
A notice is circulating on social media claiming that polling hours have been changed to begin at 4:00 AM. This notice is NOT issued by the Elections Commission.

Polling hours remain: 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Please disregard the circulating notice and report any further misinformation.
